description:
The existing GET /api/v1/backlog/pending-questions (scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog/pending_questions.go) iterates store.LoadAll(nil) in unspecified order. Extend it to sort items (and therefore the questions produced per item) by the same priority ranking the UI uses — factors in priority, blocked/unblocked status, and downstream unlock count. Find and reuse the existing ranker rather than duplicating logic (grep for 'rank', 'priority', 'unblock' under scenarios/swarm-manager/api to locate before implementing).

Also add a CLI wrapper: `swarm-manager backlog pending-questions [--json] [--source workshop|review|all] [--limit N] [--initiative NAME]` — mirror the shape of backlog list/get in scenarios/swarm-manager/cli/cmd_backlog.go. Default --source is workshop (what the new sync flow needs); review source is surfaced but unused by the MVP prep specialist.

No schema changes. No client-side ranking. Existing UI continues to work (server now returns pre-sorted; UI's own sort can be verified as a no-op post-change).
name: swarm-manager-pending-questions-priority-sort
title: Priority-sort pending-questions endpoint and add CLI wrapper
